subject: Deal Health: Weekly Signalboard & Targeted Save-Plans
messages:
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deal Health: Weekly Signalboard & Targeted Save-Plans
Attachments: novum_save_plan_v2.pdf, usage-metrics-aug.csv

Team —

Quick weekly signalboard and a targeted ask on a couple of high-risk deals. Please update stage/commit fields in HubSpot by EOD and confirm owners' save-plan actions below. Highlights: 

• Snapshot: total commit pool sits at $3.6M; top 10 deals drive 72% of next-quarter cover.
• Risk triage (red/yellow/green): I’ve flagged 6 reds, 8 yellows — see attached PDF (novum_save_plan_v2.pdf) for initial notes.

Target asks (prioritize in this order):
1) NovumAI (ND-3472) — FLAG: RED. Procurement concerns and final SLAs unresolved. Monica/Ben: own the save-plan, confirm call with Elliot and procurement today.
2) SummitHealth — YELLOW. Laura: sync with CS to lock integration timeline; confirm gating items.
3) Two mid-size deals (listed in attachment) — quick pricing follow-ups; update commit amounts.

Please reply with:
- Confirmed owners for each red deal (one-line).
- Any blocking legal/infra asks we need to escalate to solutions.

I’ll run a short triage at 3pm PT; bring prioritized bullets (30 min).

— Vivek
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal Health: Weekly Signalboard & Targeted Save-Plans
Attachments: usage-metrics-aug.csv

Thanks Vivek — I’ll take point on NovumAI.

Quick notes: we ran an updated usage projection (attached) and Novum’s current POC consumption is lower than forecast (variable compute spend is their primary concern). Procurement has pushed back on long tail retention/ingestion SLAs; legal flagged a data residency clause they may request. I’ve scheduled a 30-min sync with Elliot + their procurement on 2027-08-31 10:00 PT.

Action items I’ll execute before the 3pm triage:
- Finalize the save-plan PDF with cost/implementation levers (will attach v2).
- Pull a short playbook with fallback model-variant options that reduce infra cost by ~20% without changing core feature parity.
- Confirm what legal will accept for a scoped residency exception (if any).

Ben — can you join the call tomorrow? Your AM owner context will help on pricing dance.

— Monica
Account Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal Health: Weekly Signalboard & Targeted Save-Plans

Thanks Monica — appreciate the proactive reach. A few real constraints from our side before tomorrow’s sync:

• Pricing: Our procurement has a strict cap on TCO; we need a committed blended rate that’s within 15% of our current vendor benchmark.
• Timeline: We need a tested integration path that slots into our Q4 roadmap (Nov 1 target).
• Residency: We cannot accept a vendor-hosted EU-only residency carve; we need either a US-region SLA or a clear migration plan.

If Redwood can produce a short cost-collapse scenario (3 options: conservative, balanced, aggressive) + a one-page residency compromise we can sign off on, procurement will be in a much better place.

— Elliot
Head of Partnerships, NovumAI

Thanks for the fast responses. Short roundup & next steps after Elliot’s note: 

1) Monica + Ben — complete the 3-option cost-collapse sheet and one-page residency compromise by COB tomorrow. Use the attached template (novum_save_plan_v2.pdf) as the baseline.
2) Laura — prep a CS contingency: 2-week pilot waiver and a phased cutover plan if Novum requests US-region SLA; summarize risks and an estimate of impact to delivery dates.
3) I’ll escalate legal for a quick decision on the minimal residency language that won't expose us to regulatory risk.

If we can land the three artifacts by COB 09/01 we have a clear path to convert this red into a late-stage green. If anything blocks progress (legal, infra, or executive pricing approval), flag immediately and I’ll route to executive review.

I’ll capture outcomes in the signalboard and update the deal stage after your confirms. 3pm triage stands but will be focused on execution steps for the reds (30 minutes).

— Vivek
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
